about: Per-plugin always-on context cost, in tokens as `claude plugin details <name>` reports it, keyed by the `enabledPlugins` name in .claude/settings.json. Measured and reported every session, never capped (mantahostels#3116, ruled 6 September 2026). An `uncounted` component is one the figure omits: an MCP server's tool schemas are resolved at runtime and priced by nothing here (mantahostels#3131 measures them).
